items.title: Spring Meadow with Daisies
items.alt: Green meadow with white daisies, small pink flowers and distant blue hills under a bright sky.
items.description: Tall grass and flowers fill the lower edge, opening onto rolling fields. Soft clouds and layered hills leave an airy blue area above.

items.title: Birch Trees Around an Autumn Meadow
items.alt: White birch trunks frame an orange autumn meadow, a pond and a low sun over mountains.
items.description: Red and gold leaves hang above the open meadow. Dark evergreens stand below the distant blue mountain ridge, and light reflects in the small pond.

items.title: Snowy Village Lane
items.alt: Snow-covered village houses face a narrow lane with a distant church spire.
items.description: Warm window light contrasts with the blue snow and evening sky. Bare branches, evergreen trees and falling flakes fill the street edges.

items.title: Sunny Beach with Striped Umbrellas
items.alt: Sandy beach framed by striped umbrellas and dune grass beside turquoise waves.
items.description: Two empty wooden chairs sit beneath the left umbrella. Pale surf bands and small clouds divide the sea from the bright blue sky.

items.title: Rainbow over Rolling Green Hills
items.alt: Broad rainbow arcs between white clouds above green hills and tiny flowers.
items.description: Bushes flank the layered hills below the colorful arch. The simple cartoon shapes leave a clear patch of sky in the middle.

items.title: Sunrise above Layered Mountains
items.alt: Golden sunrise illuminates layered blue mountains above dark foreground pines.
items.description: The sun rests low on the right horizon. Rocky grass-covered slopes frame the lower edge beneath the peach-colored sky.

items.title: Desert Dunes at Sunset
items.alt: Warm sand dunes roll between tall cacti beneath a pink and orange sunset sky.
items.description: Soft purple mountains sit behind the dunes. Small desert plants punctuate the foreground while the setting sun brightens the right horizon.

items.title: Moonlit Lake and Constellations
items.alt: Full moon and small constellation lines shine above a dark mountain lake and pine silhouettes.
items.description: Cloud banks follow the distant ridges, and moonlight forms a narrow reflection on the water. The open night sky holds scattered stars.

items.title: Underwater Reef with Tropical Fish
items.alt: Blue underwater scene framed by coral, tall aquatic plants and small colorful fish.
items.description: Sunlight filters through the rippled surface above an open sandy center. Pink branches and yellow tube-like coral add color along the bottom.

items.title: Mushroom Clearing with Ferns
items.alt: Red spotted mushrooms and brown mushrooms flank a green woodland clearing.
items.description: A moss-covered stump rises behind the brown caps, while fern fronds and scattered orange leaves frame the open grassy center.

items.title: Green Chalkboard with School Doodles
items.alt: Wood-framed green chalkboard with a vertical row of colorful school doodles on the right.
items.description: A light bulb, heart, books, pencil and globe decorate one side. Most of the chalkboard remains empty for a message or lesson heading.

items.title: Ruled Notebook Page with Pencil
items.alt: Cream ruled notebook sheet with punched holes, a paper clip and yellow pencil.
items.description: A red margin line runs beside the holes on the left. The pencil lies diagonally across the lower right, leaving most ruled lines clear.

items.title: Colored Pencils and Paint Splashes
items.alt: Short colored pencils surround a cream center with bright watercolor splashes.
items.description: Cool blues and greens gather at the upper left, while reds and oranges occupy the opposite corner. Purple pencils complete the lower edge.

items.title: Science Frame with Microscope and Molecules
items.alt: Pale blue science frame with small molecular models and a microscope in the lower right.
items.description: Rounded blue and green nodes connect through short rods around the edges. The microscope tilts toward the open blue center.

items.title: Books and Trailing Plants Frame
items.alt: Stacks of old books and trailing green plants frame a cream writing area.
items.description: Tall book spines sit behind climbing vines on each side. The lower stacks rest on a narrow wooden surface beneath the empty center.

items.title: Colorful Music Notes on a Lavender Frame
items.alt: Multicolored music notes curve along staff lines above and below a lavender panel.
items.description: A large purple treble clef anchors the left edge. The gently waving staves leave the middle clear between the two musical bands.

items.title: Confetti and Streamer Celebration Frame
items.alt: Rainbow paper curls and small confetti pieces surround a cream square center.
items.description: Long red, green and yellow streamers hang from the upper corners. Smaller colored squares create a lighter border along the lower edge.

items.title: Pastel Balloon Celebration Frame
items.alt: Pastel balloons rise along both sides of a pale mint panel with confetti curls.
items.description: The balloons alternate pink, blue, yellow, lavender and mint. Their thin strings curve down beside the softly scalloped writing space.

items.title: Gold Stars on a Midnight Blue Frame
items.alt: Tiny gold stars and dots surround a deep blue panel with a fine gold border.
items.description: Notched corners interrupt the thin rectangular outline. Bright starbursts gather near the edges, keeping the dark center mostly clear.

items.title: White Flowers and Sage Leaves Frame
items.alt: White blossoms and muted green leaves decorate opposite corners of a cream panel.
items.description: Small flower clusters extend from the upper left and lower right. A thin gold outline follows the panel's gently shaped corners.

items.title: Clouds, Crescent Moons and Stars Frame
items.alt: Soft blue clouds, yellow crescent moons and stars frame a pale blue center.
items.description: The clouds gather into rounded corner groups. Smaller moons and stars link the clusters along the open sides.

items.title: Cartoon Dinosaur Valley Frame
items.alt: Three friendly cartoon dinosaurs border a sandy valley with palm trees and a distant volcano.
items.description: A blue long-necked dinosaur stands on the left, a green horned dinosaur rests near the water, and an orange dinosaur appears on the right. Their arrangement leaves a broad open path in the middle.

items.title: Smiling Planets and Rocket Space Frame
items.alt: Smiling cartoon planets surround a dark star field with a red-and-white rocket.
items.description: A blue-green planet and a ringed golden planet fill the upper corners. Orange and gray faces occupy the lower edge beneath the open space.

items.title: Red Barn beside Crop Rows
items.alt: Red barn and wooden fence overlook neat crop rows beneath a wide blue sky.
items.description: The curved red roof and white doors stand to the left of the fields. Distant hills and scattered clouds keep the upper half open.

items.title: Lavender and Butterfly Garden Frame
items.alt: Lavender sprigs, green leaves and butterflies surround a pale garden opening.
items.description: Purple flower spikes rise along both sides. Small white blossoms and yellow and violet butterflies soften the leafy border.

items.title: Watercolor Ocean Wave Panel
items.alt: Turquoise watercolor waves and white foam surround a pale watery center.
items.description: Darker curling waves collect in the lower corners. Layered translucent strokes create irregular edges along the top and sides.

items.title: Layered Paper Sunrise Landscape
items.alt: Stylized yellow sun rises behind layered orange hills and dark teal foreground shapes.
items.description: Simple cream clouds sit above the warm landscape. Curved bands and leafy silhouettes give the panel a cut-paper appearance.

items.title: Pastel Abstract Shape Frame
items.alt: Muted sage, pink, blue and lilac shapes surround an empty cream center.
items.description: Thin pale curves cross the larger color patches. Small gold dots add detail in two opposing corners.

items.title: Retro Orange Sunburst Panel
items.alt: Orange, gold and cream rays radiate from a blank circular center.
items.description: Alternating narrow and broad bands reach the rounded square edge. The flat warm palette gives the panel a vintage poster appearance.

items.title: Layered Blue Wave Business Frame
items.alt: Dark and light blue curved bands frame a large pale blue writing area.
items.description: The waves sweep across the upper left and lower right edges. Their asymmetrical curves leave an uncluttered center for a heading.

items.title: Terracotta Arch with Leaf Sprigs
items.alt: Nested terracotta and cream arches rise between two small leafy sprigs.
items.description: Warm rust-colored bands alternate around the tall central opening. Soft curved shapes fill the lower corners beneath the leaves.

items.title: Watercolor Fern Border
items.alt: Green fern fronds frame a pale sage watercolor panel.
items.description: The fronds vary in length and overlap around the sides. Soft wash texture fills the large open center.

items.title: Pink Wildflower Corner Frame
items.alt: Pink, white and violet flowers decorate opposite corners of a pale pink panel.
items.description: Thin stems and soft green leaves spread outward from the blossoms. The diagonal arrangement keeps most of the pink center clear.

items.title: Tropical Leaf Frame
items.alt: Large glossy tropical leaves surround a pale yellow-green center.
items.description: Split leaves and narrow palm fronds overlap at the corners. Their dark and light green bands create a strong leafy edge.

items.title: Lemon and Blossom Summer Frame
items.alt: Yellow lemons, sliced fruit, white blossoms and green leaves border a pale yellow panel.
items.description: Fruit clusters fill the upper left and lower right. Smaller white flowers continue along the sides between the leafy branches.

items.title: Pumpkin and Wheat Harvest Panel
items.alt: Orange pumpkins and tied wheat sheaves frame a warm parchment center.
items.description: Large wheat bundles rise at both upper sides. Small gourds and autumn leaves fill the lower corners beneath the blank panel.

items.title: Outdoor Harvest Table by a Lake
items.alt: Rustic outdoor dining table and autumn pumpkins overlook a lake and distant hills.
items.description: Fall branches frame the open sky above the table. Blankets, gourds and harvest baskets fill the foreground corners.

items.title: Christmas Lights and Evergreen Frame
items.alt: Multicolored glowing bulbs and evergreen sprigs frame a dark green panel.
items.description: The string of red, yellow, green and blue lights follows the uneven border. Small needles overlap the edge without filling the center.

items.title: Icy Blue Snowflake Frame
items.alt: White snowflakes cluster around the edges of a pale blue frosted panel.
items.description: Large branching crystals sit in the corners, with smaller flakes between them. Watercolor-like blue texture gives the center a wintry appearance.

items.title: Hanukkah Candles by a Night Window
items.alt: Eight blue candles and a taller white candle burn in a gold Hanukkah lamp beside a night window.
items.description: Gold coins fill a small blue bowl beside the lamp. On the opposite side, a blue vase with a gold star holds leafy branches against distant illuminated buildings.

items.title: Red Lantern and Blossom Frame
items.alt: Red hanging lanterns and blossoms decorate a deep red panel with fine gold trim.
items.description: Flowering branches enter from opposing corners. Gold lines and curled cloud-like motifs finish the ornamental border.

items.title: Diwali Lamps and Rangoli Frame
items.alt: Small lit clay lamps surround a purple panel with a colorful rangoli pattern.
items.description: The large floral floor pattern enters from the lower left. Golden flames and a narrow gold border brighten the otherwise open violet space.

items.title: Jack-o'-Lantern under a Crescent Moon
items.alt: Glowing jack-o'-lantern rests beneath a bare tree and crescent moon in a purple night scene.
items.description: A crooked fence runs along the lower right. Distant hills, small stars and a dark tree silhouette surround the open sky.

items.title: Easter Egg Meadow Frame
items.alt: Decorated pastel eggs and white daisies border a grassy meadow under blue sky.
items.description: Tall flowering stems climb the side edges. Different egg patterns and colors gather along the bottom, leaving the middle open.

items.title: Gingham Picnic Cloth with Strawberries
items.alt: Red-and-white checked picnic cloth holds a strawberry basket in the lower right.
items.description: Loose berries and small white blossoms spill from the wicker basket. Soft folds ripple along the cloth's outer edge.

items.title: Bakery Counter and Pastry Shelves
items.alt: Wooden bakery counter displays breads and pastries between tall plant-topped shelves.
items.description: Croissants and small cakes fill the side shelves and counter. A hanging lamp shines above the open cream wall in the center.

items.title: Sports Field and Running Track
items.alt: Striped green playing field is surrounded by a red running track beneath blue sky.
items.description: White lane markings curve across the foreground. Trees line the horizon below the large open patch of sky.

items.title: Blue City Skyline across Water
items.alt: Blue high-rise skyline stands behind green trees and a calm waterfront.
items.description: Different tower heights create a stepped silhouette across the middle. Pale reflections extend into the water below the open sky.

items.title: Decorated Kraft Paper Panel
items.alt: Torn kraft paper is decorated with leafy sprigs, daisies, paint strokes and patterned tape.
items.description: Green checked tape overlaps one corner, while mustard and purple marks color the edges. The speckled paper center stays clear.

items.title: Black Floral Border with Open Center
items.alt: Black-and-white flowers and leafy branches form a rectangular border.
items.description: Large blossoms anchor the four corners, with smaller buds along the sides. Solid black leaves contrast with the fine petal outlines.
